description: Synthetic PII test cases for mask_pii evaluation. Each has input text, expected masked output, and PII types present.

test_cases.input: No PII in this text at all, just regular stuff
test_cases.expected: No PII in this text at all, just regular stuff

test_cases.input: Account 1234567890 is ten digits not eleven
test_cases.expected: Account 1234567890 is ten digits not eleven
test_cases.note: 10-digit number should NOT be masked as NIN

test_cases.input: The year 2024 should not be masked
test_cases.expected: The year 2024 should not be masked
test_cases.note: Short numbers should not be masked

test_cases.input: Email me at info@naijaml.com for support
Abeg send money to my GTBank, my number na 08071234567
test_cases.expected: Abeg send money to my GTBank, my number na [PHONE]

test_cases.input: Text with ₦5,000 amount should keep amount by default
test_cases.expected: Text with ₦5,000 amount should keep amount by default
test_cases.note: Naira amounts not masked by default

test_cases.input: Lagos is beautiful and Nigeria has 36 states
test_cases.expected: Lagos is beautiful and Nigeria has 36 states

test_cases.note: NIN is 11 digits not starting with 22 or 0
BVN and NIN correctly differentiated in same text
